staff.heading: Data requests
staff.intro: Requests to see, move, correct or delete someone’s data. Each one must be answered within a month of the day it reached us; the list shows the nearest deadline first.
staff.notAllowed: Only owner, admin and support staff handle data requests.

identity.not_needed: Not needed: made inside the account
identity.denied: The person says it wasn’t them

new.heading: Log a data request
new.intro: Find the person, then say what they asked for, how it reached us and when. The deadline is one month from the date received.
new.findHint: A username, a pen name, a whole email address or a user ID. Finding someone by email is logged.
new.pickHint: Pick the account the request is about.
new.matchNoHandle: An account with no username yet
new.receivedHint: Not in the future. The deadline is one month from this date.
new.noteHint: Only staff read it. Never paste the person’s email, documents or data here.

page.heading: Data request {{reference}}
page.under16: This person is under 16, so the request goes through their parent or guardian, never only through the account.
page.identityExplainAsk: This request didn’t come from inside the account. Ask the person to confirm it was theirs: they get a notice they can’t switch off, emailed to the account’s own address, and answer in Settings, under Data requests. Nothing goes to any other address.
page.identityExplainAsked: We asked the person to confirm. Their answer will show here.
page.identityExplainDone: Signing in to their own account is the check. The answer is in the audit log.
page.extendHint: Up to two more months in all, and only within the first month. The person is told the new deadline and why.
page.extendTooLate: The first month is over, so the deadline can no longer be extended.
page.closeHint: Say what was done. It stays in the log as our proof; the person doesn’t read it.
page.closedNote: This request is closed and can’t be changed.
page.extendedFully: The deadline already has the most extra time the law allows: two more months.

failures.not_allowed: Only owner, admin and support staff handle data requests.
failures.no_such_person: That account doesn’t exist any more. Search again.
failures.bad_date: The date received can’t be in the future.
failures.note_too_long: The note is too long: keep it under 2000 characters.
failures.request_closed: This request is closed and can’t be changed.
failures.reason_needed: Say why you need more time, in at most 1000 characters.
failures.bad_months: Pick more time than the deadline already has.
failures.too_late: The first month is over, so the deadline can no longer be extended.
failures.no_check_needed: This request was made inside the account, so it needs no check.
failures.parent_needed: This person is under 16: the check goes to their parent or guardian.
failures.outcome_needed: Say what was done, in at most 2000 characters.
failures.refused: That wasn’t saved. Check the fields and try again.
failures.unreachable: We couldn’t reach the database. Try again in a moment.

mine.heading: Data requests
mine.intro: Your requests to see, move, correct or delete your data, and when we’ll answer.
mine.loadFailed: We couldn’t load your data requests. Try again later.
mine.title: {{reference}}: {{type}}
mine.question: This request reached us {{channel}}, not from inside your account. Was it you?
mine.denied: You told us it wasn’t you. We won’t act on it, and we’ll look into it.
mine.answerFailed: We couldn’t save your answer. Try again.
mine.notWaiting: We’re no longer waiting for an answer on this request.
